'''2007 Dantooine Regionals Thomas Whaley LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2007 Dantooine Regionals]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
